newsitem.title: JAPAN: TOCOM raises Dec, Jan rubber futures margin fees.
newsitem.headline: TOCOM raises Dec, Jan rubber futures margin fees.

text.p: The Tokyo Commodity Exchange (TOCOM) said on Wednesday that it would raise the margin requirements on its December and January rubber futures contracts, effective from Thursday.
It will raise its margin requirement on the December contract by 20,000 yen per trading lot, bringing the total December requirement to 147,750 yen, TOCOM said.

The margin for the January contract will increase by 10,000 yen per lot to 62,500 yen. The increases are intended to cool overheated trade. The requirement on other rubber contracts will be unchanged at 52,500 yen, TOCOM said.
